findings.claim: CARR 10-K 風險因素：競爭對手可能開發出先於或取代其產品被市場接受的競爭技術；客戶亦可能引入非傳統商業模式或顛覆性技術與產品；運輸冷凍客戶的關係企業已生產競爭的冷凍機組。
findings.excerpt: Our competitors may develop competing technologies that gain market acceptance before or instead of our products.

findings.claim: ACHR News 2026 展望：預期2026年有一波併購潮，大型業者競相取得技術、工程人才與智慧財產權。
findings.source: ACHR News, 7 predictions for HVAC in 2026
findings.excerpt: Expect a wave of acquisitions in 2026, as both outside investors and HVAC's largest players race to secure technology, engineering talent, and intellectual property
